overviews.name: VSAMMQ
key_points: Serves two MQ request/reply inquiries from CICS: account details read from the VSAM account file (transaction CDRA) and the system date and time (transaction CDRD).
Read-only towards account data: the only file command is a READ of ACCTDAT; everything else it produces is a reply or error message on an MQ queue.

descriptions.name: COACCT01
descriptions.description: Answers MQ account inquiries: reads an INQA request with an account id, reads the account from CICS file ACCTDAT and puts the account details on the reply queue.
key_points: Started with an MQ trigger message: RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM) supplies the input queue name; the reply queue is the literal CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT and errors go to CARD.DEMO.ERROR.

For function INQA with a non-zero key it reads ACCTDAT by account id and replies with status, balance, limits, dates and group id; a not-found key or any other request gets an 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS' reply.
Loops MQGET under syncpoint, taking a CICS SYNCPOINT before each further get, until no message is left, then closes the queues and returns.

descriptions.name: CODATE01
descriptions.description: Answers MQ system date inquiries: for each request message it takes the CICS date and time and puts 'SYSTEM DATE / SYSTEM TIME' on the reply queue.
key_points: Started with an MQ trigger message: RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM) supplies the input queue name; the reply queue is the literal CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE and errors go to CARD.DEMO.ERROR.
Each request is answered from EXEC CICS ASKTIME / FORMATTIME (MM-DD-YYYY and time); the request content is not examined and no file is read.
